checks.description: All dynamic parameters pass through escapeHtml() converting &, <, >, ", '
Cryptographically secure tokens (crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex")) used for email verification and password resets
Password reset tokens expire in 1 hour; email verification tokens expire in 24 hours
Tokens are invalidated in the database immediately upon successful verification or password reset
Password reset and resend verification endpoints are protected by rate limiters (authRateLimiter)
SMTP passwords and token secrets are never logged in plaintext
